Collect published real income levels or percent changes
Compute within-city gap in pp; not annual growth
Plot grouped bars with mismatched cohort footnotes

All four values describe cumulative 2013–2024 real growth

training_pair.instruction: Create the reusable chart from exact published values, retaining cohort definitions, units, provenance, and the source-visual uncertainty.
training_pair.response: Read adjacent data.csv and config.json. Execute 'python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output artifacts/source.png', repeat with --theme neutral. chart.py implements render(data,theme,context)->fig. CSV fields: city, group_code, income_group, value_pct, unit, period, denominator, provenance, source_detail; actual observations and per-field provenance are in data_spec.values. Only change THEME/CONTEXT/CSV for reuse. No source graphic, human approval or model training supplied.
